title: Priority performance poster and digital ticket
slide_intent: Carry a typographic voice between promotion and practical information so the experience remains connected after a person chooses an event.
strategic_value: O2 can connect the excitement of an artist announcement with the utility of a ticket through blue fields and consistent type character.
demonstration: A performance poster at left uses oversized white artist lettering across the photograph; a rounded digital ticket at right presents a different artist, date, seating fields and QR code on a blue-to-warm gradient.
practical_value: Change information density for the task while preserving shared color and type cues.

content_islands.name: Artist poster
content_islands.spec: Place the performance photograph and large two-line name in the left panel with venue text below.

content_islands.name: Ticket hierarchy
content_islands.spec: On the right, place the Priority label and O2 mark above the artist, event details, seat fields and centered QR code.

reference_purposes.Expression: Large rounded artist names and blue fields connect the two different formats.
reference_purposes.Application: The source compares a promotional poster with a digital ticket containing operational details.
